dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What has the expeditionary force been up to recently?

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: The expeditionary force is currently dispersed throughout Nod-Krai, conducting operations against various threats: the Wild Hunt, the Fatui...

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: While we've dealt with quite a few troublesome enemies on this long expedition... this is the first time we've encountered a place this chaotic.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: But, as the Grand Master once said, the Knights' responsibilities are the same no matter where we are: aid the distressed and help the poor, punish the wicked and champion the good.
